id_egg_wall.blurb: Egg Wall sits on the northwest side of the big Castle Rock formation at Castle Rocks, near Almo in south Idaho. It is a small, easygoing wall with about eleven climbs, mixing bolted lines and gear routes. Grades run from around 5.6 up to a single 5.10, with most of the climbing in the 5.8 and 5.9 range, so it suits newer leaders and anyone after a relaxed day. The rock is generally slabby and kicks back steeper as you near the anchors. The ground below the wall is fairly level, which makes it comfortable for staging gear and belaying, and it works well as a warm-up stop alongside the formation's longer routes.
